wholePhysicalScope: The named 25.24 m by 29.62 m native envelope and signed boulevard frontage fix the complex. Published architectural descriptions distinguish the paired churches and their shared western narthex and eastern apses.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the two church volumes, their lead domes and the slender minaret. Closer levels add recessed arched windows, stone bands and cream lattices.
limitations: The model depicts the September 2020 exterior, with the joined church volumes and later minaret.
Mapped footprint and documented church layout constrain the reconstruction. Roof sections, rear windows, apses and ornamental bands are working estimates.
The original terrain remains intact. The foundation uses approximate local paving grade.
